AEGIS – Every Marswalk Deserves a Way Home

AEGIS is an innovative concept that uses NASA's open data to make Mars exploration safer and smarter. By combining terrain analysis, scientific priorities, and risk assessment, it aims to help astronauts choose safer routes, identify valuable exploration sites, and plan alternative paths in emergencies.

AEGIS goes beyond mapping Mars: it helps astronauts explore confidently and return safely.
